== Summary ==
Identified: none. The player in a dark-green zip hoodie, olive tee, glasses, and a graphic face mask is the same man as [[:File:2021 World Championship player during a match 2.jpg]] and the opponent whose green sleeve is in [[:File:2021 World Championship feature table game 4.jpg]]. Faces unlabeled.
A player at the feature table. Taken at the [[2021 World Championship]] (the Hyatt Regency Crystal City, Arlington, Virginia, 8–10 October 2021).
